method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: Collection from the paying parent: registration and private vs Registrar collection (ss 17, 23-25, 30, 37B, 38-39); employer withholding (ss 43-47, 49, 50, 57, 65AA); due dates and late payment penalty (ss 66-68); credits (ss 71, 71C); tax refunds, third-party notices and Centrelink deductions (ss 72, 72A, 72AA); departure prohibition orders (ss 72D-72F, 72I, 72L); payee suits (ss 30(3), 113, 113A); this Act's silence on debt agreements and bankruptcy. Out: the amount of child support, overseas and transferred liabilities, Register particulars, employers' own penalties and records, ss 69-69B, 71AA-71B, 71D-71E, 72AB-72C, departure procedure, the Account, suspension, objections and review, administration.
lives: jake k072 (2039-01-15): three missed payments; the Registrar collects by deduction from his wages
